product.title: Front Office Draft
product.summary: Build an analytics department for ten million dollars.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students hire from seven candidates and buy from three tools inside a fixed budget. Score combines the analytics value added, a culture multiplier, a risk penalty and a scalability bonus, and clearing the threshold reveals a claim code.

facilitation.notes: The README directs students to submit the claim code through a BOW Finish Form, which is not in this repo.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete and publicly reachable, with a genuine v2 engineering plan whose first item is already implemented in the shipped code. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Strong complementarity puzzle with real synergy and conflict penalties, undermined by contradictory scoring shown on one screen.
knownBlockers: Two different numbers are both labelled "Final Score" on the results screen at once — a live preview reading 10.4 sits directly above an official rating of 4.9 out of 7.0.

curation.tierBasis: A complementarity puzzle with real synergy and conflict penalties and four hidden combinations to find. Two different numbers are labelled Final Score on the same results screen.

provenance.evidence: 201-M3-L3/js/data.js SUCCESS_THRESHOLD 7.0 and claim code 'BOW-201-M3-EDGE-01', which the bundled xlsx also carries — the workbook is a parallel implementation of the same activity.
